description: This file is the code-behind for the MCQ set management page in an online examination system. It handles user interactions such as selecting courses, adding questions, setting exams, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the ASP.NET web page for setting and managing MCQ questions and exams

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently commented out, possibly used for session initialization

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new MCQ question into the database and updates the question number

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up an exam for the selected course and assigns an exam number

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown based on the selected semester

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on the selected course

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to Login Page
